title: Email Authentication Success
description: Verify that a user can successfully log in using valid Email credentials via Supabase Auth.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page.
Enter a valid registered Email and correct password.
Submit the login form.
Verify login is successful and user is redirected to the Dashboard.

title: Email Authentication Failure with Incorrect Password
description: Ensure the system properly handles login attempts with incorrect passwords for Email authentication.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page.
Enter a valid registered Email and an incorrect password.
Submit the login form.
Verify login fails with appropriate error message and user remains on the login page.

title: Dashboard Metrics Display
description: Verify the Dashboard page correctly loads and displays all project statistics, total revenue, open proposals, and active construction sites.

steps.description: Log in successfully and navigate to the Dashboard page.
Check that project statistics are correctly fetched and displayed.
Validate total revenue is accurately shown.
Confirm the count and details of open proposals are visible.
Verify active construction sites are listed correctly.

title: Dashboard Load Failure Handling
description: Ensure the Dashboard page displays meaningful error messages when backend metrics fail to load.

steps.description: Simulate backend failure or network error during Dashboard data fetch.
Navigate to the Dashboard page.
Check that appropriate error notifications or messages are displayed to the user.
Verify that the UI does not crash and user can retry or navigate elsewhere.

title: Create New Construction Project
description: Verify that users can create a new construction project with mandatory fields including budget and inspection data.

steps.description: Log in and navigate to the Projects page.
Click 'Create New Project' button.
Input valid project name, description, budget amount, and inspection details.
Submit the new project form.
Confirm the new project is listed in the Projects page with correct details.

title: Project Creation with Missing Required Fields
description: Ensure project creation form validation prevents submission when mandatory fields are missing or invalid.

steps.description: Navigate to the Projects page and select to create a new project.
Leave mandatory fields such as project name or budget blank.
Attempt to submit the form.
Verify form validation messages are shown and submission is blocked.

title: Edit Existing Project
description: Verify the user can update details of an existing construction project including budget and inspection data.

steps.description: Navigate to the Projects page.
Select an existing project from the list.
Modify project name, budget, or inspection information.
Save the updates.
Check that the updated project details are saved and reflected in the project list.

title: Delete Construction Project
description: Ensure the user can delete a construction project and it is removed from the project listing.

steps.description: Navigate to the Projects page.
Select a project and click the delete option.
Confirm the deletion action.
Verify the project is removed from the project list.

title: Update User Profile Information
description: Verify that the user can update personal profile information in the Settings page and changes persist after reload.

steps.description: Navigate to the Settings page.
Change fields such as user name, email (if allowed), and other profile details.
Save the changes.
Verify changes are saved and persist after navigating away and returning to Settings.

title: Update Company Details with Logo and CNPJ
description: Check that company details including the logo and CNPJ can be updated and are shown correctly in Settings.

steps.description: Open the Settings page.
Update company name, upload a new logo image, and enter valid CNPJ information.
Save all updates.
Confirm the company details including logo and CNPJ display correctly on the Settings screen and persist.

title: Theme Toggle Light to Dark Mode
description: Verify the user can toggle between light and dark themes in the Settings page or sidebar toggle control, and theme persists on reload.

steps.description: Locate and use the theme toggle control on sidebar or in Settings.
Switch from light mode to dark mode and observe UI changes.
Verify UI updates accordingly to chosen theme colors.
Reload the application or revisit the page.
Confirm the selected theme preference is retained and applied.

title: Responsive Layout on Different Screen Sizes
description: Check that the app layout including sidebar navigation adapts properly to different screen widths, including mobile and desktop resolutions.

steps.description: Resize the browser window to various widths including small (mobile) and large (desktop) resolutions.
Verify the sidebar navigation collapses or expands appropriately.
Confirm all content remains visible and UI elements are usable at each resolution.

title: Construction Cost Calculator Accuracy with Valid Inputs
description: Verify that the cost estimation calculator computes accurate construction costs based on given input parameters.

steps.description: Navigate to the Calculator page.
Input valid project parameters such as area size, material types, labor hours, and other relevant costs.
Trigger the calculation.
Verify the resulting cost estimate reflects input values and expected cost formulas.

title: Calculator Input Validation and Error Handling
description: Ensure the calculator prevents invalid or missing inputs and shows appropriate error messages.

steps.description: Navigate to the Calculator tool.
Enter invalid values such as negative numbers, non-numeric inputs, or leave required fields blank.
Attempt to compute the cost estimation.
Validate error messages display for invalid inputs and calculation is blocked.

title: Integration Success with Supabase Edge Functions
description: Verify that calls to Supabase Edge Functions succeed and return expected results when invoked from the application.

steps.description: Trigger application features that rely on Supabase Edge Function calls (e.g., data fetching, AI requests).
Verify that calls return successful responses with correct data.
Confirm UI updates reflect the received data accurately.

title: Error Handling for Supabase Edge Functions Failures
description: Ensure the application properly handles failed calls to Supabase Edge Functions and displays meaningful error messages to the user.

steps.description: Simulate failures or timeouts in Supabase Edge Function calls.
Perform actions triggering these calls.
Verify that user-friendly error messages are shown.
Confirm the application does not crash and offers retry or graceful degradation.

title: Integration Success with Gemini AI API
description: Validate that functions utilizing Gemini AI services via integration return successful AI-powered results and update the UI accordingly.

steps.description: Execute features that rely on Gemini AI integration such as advanced backend processing.
Verify AI responses are received and the interface reflects these outputs properly.

title: Error Handling for Gemini AI API Failures
description: Ensure appropriate handling and user notification on failures or invalid responses from Gemini AI integration.

steps.description: Simulate Gemini AI API failure scenarios.
Trigger dependent application functionalities.
Verify meaningful error messages are displayed.
Check that the app continues to operate without crashing.
